models.label: Omni Flash
models.native_spoken_audio_notes: Generate the approved spoken performance in the same video request. Preserve one speaker identity, emotional delivery, and the declared lip-sync or character-voiceover relationship across adjacent segments.
hard_rules: Every segment must receive character, scene, and key-action anchors in that order where distinct images are available.
In the final provider prompt, refer to files strictly by local multipart order as @image1, @image2, @image3, and so on.
Keep each segment within the selected reference image limit.
A reference video may be used only as motion, camera, rhythm, or composition guidance; do not copy its identity, text, watermark, or branding.

models.label: Seedance 2.0 Mini
models.native_spoken_audio_notes: Seedance receives the approved English spoken copy together with concise Chinese visual direction. Prefer native expressive speech; local dubbing is a bounded fallback after native-audio failure or an explicit user request.
hard_rules: Preserve the user-confirmed reference image order and use @image1, @image2, and later numbers only for the matching uploaded image.
Human faces in references must be unmistakably fictional stylized animation; photorealistic, hyperreal, live-action, or real-person-looking faces are not provider-safe.
Use human, character, product, scene, and action references only when they are relevant to the current segment.
Keep each segment within the selected reference image limit.
A reference video may be used only as motion, camera, rhythm, or composition guidance; do not copy its identity, text, watermark, or branding.
